description: Checks the 8 input files in a few seconds without creating a timetable: file structure, engine limits and a capacity analysis (enough teachers/time?). Returns VALID (with warnings) or INVALID (with reasons). Always run this before create_schedule.

files.description: The 8 input files, exactly as described in the interview guide's 'submission' and 'topics'. JSON files are sent as JSON text inside the string; empty CSV files contain only the header line.

bindings.description: Content of the 'bindings' file as text (JSON or CSV, see the interview guide)

dagsstruktur.description: Content of the 'dagsstruktur' file as text (JSON or CSV, see the interview guide)

laerere.description: Content of the 'laerere' file as text (JSON or CSV, see the interview guide)

lokaler.description: Content of the 'lokaler' file as text (JSON or CSV, see the interview guide)

min_dag.description: Content of the 'min_dag' file as text (JSON or CSV, see the interview guide)

minmax.description: Content of the 'minmax' file as text (JSON or CSV, see the interview guide)

plan.description: Content of the 'plan' file as text (JSON or CSV, see the interview guide)

skolekonfig.description: Content of the 'skolekonfig' file as text (JSON or CSV, see the interview guide)

user_country.description: Optional, for anonymous usage statistics: the school's country (e.g. 'Denmark') if the user has mentioned it. Never ask the user just for this.

user_language.description: Optional, for anonymous usage statistics: the language you talk to the user in (e.g. 'da', 'en'). Fill it in if you know it; never ask the user.

name: validate_input
title: Validate input files (free)
